mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sessions ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sessions (id, status, model, max_turns, cost, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{status}, #{model}, #{maxTurns}, #{cost}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
